newsitem.title: USA: Ill. Quad Cities 2 nuclear unit resumes full power.
newsitem.headline: Ill. Quad Cities 2 nuclear unit resumes full power.

text.p: The 789 megawatt (MW) Quad Cities 2 nuclear unit resumed full power after its output was reduced over the weekend for valve repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday.
Power level at the Cordova, Ill., unit was dropped to 200 MW during work to correct a packing leak on a containment valve used in the reactor water cleanup system.
The nearby Quad Cities unit 1 was operating at 100 percent of its 789 MW capacity, NRC said in its daily status report.
Commonwealth Edison, a subsidiary of Unicom Corp, is operator and 75 percent owner of the Quad Cities units. The remaining 25 percent is held by Iowa-Illinois Gas & Electric.
